about: Visual assets of the Episode 2 build (K3.1): every picture file and font the render page loads. The page (animatic/src/page.html + design/c3/final/src engines) draws everything in canvas 2D from project code and data; it loads no image, PDF, 3D model or texture file (no three.js in this episode). Fonts are matched by family (document.fonts).
note: thumbnails (C6) are added here with their generator when they exist
